qualification: physical device measurement; single run per row; not a release gate
device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, CUDA, device 0 shared with an interactive desktop

input.poses: 356 recorded centre-drag detector geometries (annulus 40.25-91.75 px) replayed in order through detector.prepare / masked_sum

protocol: replay the recorded poses with the previous decoder and the grouped-refill decoder on the same resident sources; CUDA events around the plan+residual launches; Nsight Compute on launch 40 of the same replay; outputs compared as SHA-256 of every masked sum, five frames and fifteen block decodes

rows.measurement: Nsight Compute, one launch: executed warp instructions
Nsight Compute, one launch: duration ms
rows.note: compute-bound (ALU pipe 81 percent) at twelve sources; the residual decoder is 88 percent of a viewer's query time and the plan kernel 10 percent (nsys over a 4 s centre drag at 69 sources)

rejected.variant: eager refill on the critical path (load, combine, pop each pair)
rejected.why: fewer instructions (789M) but the refill load waits before every symbol; eligible warps 1.45 versus 3.48
